name: services/courses/units
description:
Get information on multiple course units.

This method is similar to the unit method, but it works with multiple units. It also has a limited fields support.
brief_description: Get information on multiple course units.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of unit method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary: your unit_ids will be mapped to dictionary's keys, and each value will contain the description of a course, as defined in the unit method (or null if the given unit_id has not been found).
